sign_in.title: Welcome back
sign_in.subtitle: Sign in with the account your administrator provided. After your password, you’ll enter a code from your authenticator.
sign_in.provisioned_only: Accounts are provisioned by an administrator. Public registration is not available.

local_dev.title: Enter the Portal quickly
local_dev.subtitle: This localhost page supports fast integration testing. Start it with the dedicated bypass command to use any non-empty account and password.
local_dev.warning: Password and TOTP are skipped only when started with npm run cf:dev:portal-bypass. Standard local startup keeps normal validation.
local_dev.helper: Available only on localhost / 127.0.0.1 when the server explicitly enables local bypass.

setup.title: Complete account setup
setup.subtitle: Create your password, then connect an authenticator. This invitation link can only be used once.
setup.password_hint: Use 14–128 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.

totp_setup.title: Set up verification codes
totp_setup.subtitle: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app. If no QR code is available, enter the key manually.
totp_setup.no_external_qr: QR codes use server-provided local data only. Your TOTP secret is never sent to an external QR service.
totp_setup.confirm_label: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.subtitle: Enter the current 6-digit code from the authenticator connected to {{email}}.
verify.recovery_hint: Each recovery code can only be used once.

recovery_codes.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery_codes.subtitle: If your authenticator is unavailable, use one of these codes to sign in.
recovery_codes.warning: These codes may only be shown once. Store them in a password manager or another secure place and never share them.
